videos.title: Money for Nothing
videos.description: Your dedications and song requests from the 1950s-90s. Can you guess the Stuck in the Middle song? Text 81012, email moneyfornothing@bbc.co.uk or call 03700 100 110.

videos.title: Lucy Owen
videos.description: Strictly finalist and musical star Layton Williams chats about his tour, Layton Live, plus Bill's Included stars Yasmin Al-Khudhairi and Harry Baxendale on working with Rob Brydon.

videos.title: Radio Wales Sport
videos.description: Live commentary, guests and analysis. Your home for Welsh sport.

videos.title: 18 Again (Tori James)
videos.description: Cerys Matthews talks to record-breaking mountaineer Tori James about the music, film, fashion and fads of 1999, the year she turned 18.

videos.title: Scrum V Live
videos.description: Live commentary of Wales v Australia in the Nations Championship. Kick-off 8.10pm.

videos.title: BBC Introducing with Adam Walton
videos.description: The best in new Welsh music, exclusive sessions, interviews and demos.

videos.title: Relax with Radio Wales
videos.description: Relax, unwind and chill out with an hour of classic and contemporary tunes.

videos.title: As BBC Radio 5 Live
videos.description: See listings for BBC Radio 5 Live on BBC Sounds.

videos.title: The Aberystwyth Book Club
videos.description: In this festive special, our group of book lovers discuss Sharp as Any Thorn, a cosy crime novel set in 1950s Aberystwyth by Sue McCormick. Did our readers solve the mystery.

videos.title: Man Alive
videos.description: Shining a light on the growing mental health crisis among men in the UK. We dismantle the barriers that prevent men from seeking help. Contains scenes which some viewers may find upsetting.

videos.title: Country Focus
videos.description: Programme serving everyone living in the countryside and tackling the issues affecting them. With rural, farming and environmental news.

videos.title: Celebration
videos.description: Father Richard Green looks ahead to Doctor Who Day with a service on time.

videos.title: Sunday Supplement
videos.description: Vaughan Roderick with political news, discussions analysis.

videos.title: All Things Considered
videos.description: Jonathan Thomas looks at the life and legacy of St Francis of Assisi, including his transformation from rich playboy to a begging friar tending to society's outcasts and very poor.

videos.title: Owen Money's Solid Gold Sunday
videos.description: A second dose of Owen Money for the weekend. It's nonstop music all the way, with classics from the 60s, 70s and 80s, plus your dedications.

videos.title: Robin Morgan
videos.description: Robin brings you the best in music and guests for your Sunday afternoon. Call 03700 100 110 Text 81012 or message us via X @bbcradiowales.

videos.title: Lynn Bowles
videos.description: Music, entertainment and great guests for your Sunday afternoon.

videos.title: Roy Noble
videos.description: Roy meets Peter Ellis, who grew up in Kenya with a lion cub called Prince. Plus Steven John on forgotten war heroes, and Roy's Pick explores Kyffin Williams.

videos.title: Bennett Arron's Big Welsh Con
videos.description: Welsh comedian, and one of the UK's first major identity theft victims, Bennett Arron investigates why North Wales has become the UK's online fraud hotspot.

videos.title: Celebration (Evening Edition)
videos.description: Father Richard Green looks ahead to Doctor Who Day with a service on time.

videos.title: Celtic Heartbeat
videos.description: Frank Hennessy presents the best in folk, roots and acoustic music from the Celtic countries and beyond.

videos.title: Beverley's World of Music
videos.description: The finest musical melodies, exquisite performances from stage and screen, and orchestral and choral works from Wales and the world. There's no need to book your seat, just listen and relax.

videos.title: As BBC Radio 5 Live
videos.description: See listings for BBC Radio 5 Live on BBC Sounds.

videos.title: Radio Wales News Update
videos.description: The latest news from Wales and the world.

videos.title: Wake Up with Radio Wales
videos.description: A lively mix of music to start the day. Perfect for your pod.

videos.title: The Aberystwyth Book Club
videos.description: In this festive special, our group of book lovers discuss Sharp as Any Thorn, a cosy crime novel set in 1950s Aberystwyth by Sue McCormick. Did our readers solve the mystery.

videos.title: Radio Wales Breakfast
videos.description: Everything you need to know as you wake up.

videos.title: Justine Jones
videos.description: Justine brightens your morning with great music and entertainment. Call 03700 100 110 Text 81012 or message via X @bbcradiowales.

videos.title: The Phone In
videos.description: Be part of the nation's conversation.

videos.title: Behnaz Akhgar
videos.description: Celebrity guests, TV Turn Ons, and we test your anagram-solving skills with The Name Game. Call or WhatsApp 03700 100 110 Text 81012.

videos.title: Radio Wales Drive
videos.description: Everything you need to know as you head home.

videos.title: Jacko's Sporting Amanac
videos.description: 1/3. Peter Jackson recalls the triumph and tragedy of one of Wales's greatest all-round sportsman: Maurice Turnbull.

videos.title: Huw Stephens
videos.description: Huw Stephens plays classic tracks, introduces his Artist of the Week and features new music from Wales and beyond.

videos.title: Eleri Siôn
videos.description: Eleri brightens your night-time with great music and chat. Call 03700 100 110 Text 81012 or via X @bbcradiowales.
